content.text:
Are you looking for **the text/download** of **Volume V**?

A likely match is **_The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night — Volume 05 of 10_**, translated by **Richard F. Burton**. It’s available free on **Project Gutenberg** in HTML/EPUB/Kindle/plain-text formats. ([gutenberg.org](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/3439?utm_source=openai))

If you specifically mean **_The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night_** — the **John Payne** translation, not Burton’s similarly titled **“and a Night”** — that work is available on Wikisource, and Payne’s translation was originally published in nine volumes. ([en.wikisource.org](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Book_of_the_Thousand_Nights_and_One_Night?utm_source=openai))

**Quick distinction:**
- **John Payne:** _The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night_  
- **Richard F. Burton:** _The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night_
